rows.area: Stage-0 pin and compiler source profile
rows.claim: mncs-compiler is pinned to current Rust Stage-0 709ba008 at Profile 0.18, and the seven current compiler source modules declare Profile 0.18.
exceptions: The native parser rejects five sampled Profile 0.18 source forms; see CP-0015.

rows.claim: kernel.same_source returns the oracle result for empty, identical, unequal, and prefix-related byte fixtures in the current frontend suite.
For the tested bounded ASCII domain, current native token kinds, byte spans, lexical diagnostics, line/column facts, and token-shape invariants match Stage-0.
exceptions: The native source gate remains ASCII-only (CP-0002); this does not claim Unicode parity or whole-module capacity.

rows.claim: The supported bounded header fixtures match current Stage-0 spans and established module spelling.
exceptions: Leading-comment profile-envelope input still produces MNE002 (CP-0006); declarations after the header are outside this slice.

rows.claim: The declaration and flow interfaces accept source through four byte-sequence chunks capped at 64 bytes each, and the segment corpus exercises total sources up to 256 bytes.
exceptions: There is no scalable source-unit/project snapshot representation; 256 bytes is a compiler interface limit, not a language bound.

rows.claim: Current Stage-0 accepts five tested forms that native decl.parse_unit rejects under current Profile 0.18 compiler modules.
exceptions: The five cases are bare !, negative atom, repeat literal, next field, and integer match; this is compiler architecture pressure CP-0015.

rows.claim: Three positive and three negative bounded declarations agree structurally or by first-error span; three check_unit symbol/resolve/IR verdicts agree with Stage-0.
exceptions: This is a bounded grammar subset and not whole-project compilation.

rows.claim: The tested local functions, calls, parameters, lets, records, and field projections pass the native declaration/proof checks.
exceptions: Imported names and cross-module type/value resolution are not implemented by the native compiler.

rows.claim: The native prove_unit corpus matches current Stage-0 FAIL codes/spans and proof verdicts over 49 cases, with five verifier verdicts, repeated identically.
exceptions: Contracts, unsupported syntax, and broader Rust proof surfaces are outside the tested native subset.

rows.claim: Native proof constructs typed postfix operations and rejects the tested sabotaged proof values with its stack/type-shape verifier.
exceptions: The current differential does not establish structural identity with Rust body/SSA values.

rows.claim: flow.lower_unit emits checked branch/jump/return/fail blocks, attaches each proof operation once in source order, and matches Rust diagnostics/spans and positive branch/return control shape across four cases and 20 repeated requests.
exceptions: Blocks do not carry Rust-equivalent SSA values or merge values and do not emit executable code.

rows.area: Project source discovery and import resolution
rows.claim: No native compiler path discovers source modules or resolves imported declarations across a project.
exceptions: The Stage-0 probe's linked library loader is test/bootstrap transport, not native compiler behavior.

rows.claim: Current Stage-0 accepts the tested Unicode module name while native source admission remains ASCII-only.
exceptions: Native Unicode property classification and scalar-width spans are not implemented.

rows.area: Rust value-carrying body/SSA and callable resolution
rows.claim: The native CFG has no SSA value graph, merge values, resolved callable identities, or Rust-compatible body lowering.
exceptions: flow-abi-current records Stage-0 callable identities, not native compiler output identities.

rows.claim: Native support for current Profile 0.18 process start/observe/cancel/reap and its resource contract was not exercised by this compiler workload.
exceptions: No native parity or absence claim is made beyond this campaign's tested slice.

rows.claim: The current compiler campaign did not exercise native compilation of the generic sequence/query library surface.
exceptions: Stage-0 acceptance of sequence syntax is not native compiler parity.

rows.area: Structured artifact projection and native artifact contracts
rows.claim: The current compiler flow did not project output through typed structured artifact contracts.
exceptions: Stage-0 artifact/callable metadata is recorded as authority; it is not reimplemented natively.

rows.claim: The MNCS compiler emits no native target executable or Rust-equivalent backend artifact.
exceptions: The production call result is an artifact for executing MNCS code under Stage-0, not compiled target output.

rows.claim: Tested semantic FAIL and flow MNB038 diagnostic codes/spans match current Stage-0.
exceptions: Full message text, recovery behavior, Unicode spans, and the CP-0006 envelope case remain incomplete.

rows.claim: Current native declaration, semantic, frontend, segment, and flow suites repeat with identical normalized result digests.
exceptions: Repeated results show determinism only; Rust differential and explicit invariants provide correctness evidence.

rows.area: Stage-0 compile and linked artifact cost
rows.claim: The current linked kernel compile completes twice in about 15 seconds with byte-identical semantic/HIR/SSA outputs and 213 CMP301 obligations.
exceptions: This is Stage-0 reference cost; native compile cost, peak memory, and complete obligation discharge are unmeasured.

rows.area: Self-hosting, incremental workspaces, and cache invalidation
rows.claim: No Stage-1/Stage-2 compiler comparison or native incremental project graph is claimed.
exceptions: Stage-0 still loads and executes all MNCS compiler code.
